{{Top|leg}}
'''Combat guilds''' were organizations existing throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that trained civilians in military-style combat. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] often visited trainers in combat guild halls in order to be trained to ranged, melee or [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. One such combat guild was [[Bestine Combat Guild Hall|based]] out of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
